review:
A wizard cat runs a magic soup shop on a tiny 3x3 grid. Every 10 spins the cat writes a recipe of three ingredients, and collecting them on the middle reel opens the bonus.

In the bonus there are six jars and you open three. Their multipliers get multiplied together and applied to your bet – jars with the recipe ingredients hold bigger ones – and a flask multiplier can grow to 512x. Medium volatility, 8,000x max, and a 98.06% RTP: the highest on our whole site. Charming and genuinely different.
pros: Excellent 98.06% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
